name: monaco-editor
label: Monaco Editor
description: The VS Code editor as a Blade component — syntax highlighting, themes, auto dark mode, and many languages. Lazy-loads its bundle on demand.

props.name: theme
props.description: Editor color theme. 'auto' follows the .dark class.

props.name: height
props.description: Editor height in px (or a CSS value).

studio.card: Loads the Monaco bundle — open the docs to preview.

usage: Requires the JS bundle: php artisan vendor:publish --tag=devdojo-assets

examples.title: Basic
examples.description: Syntax highlighting for JavaScript, with auto dark mode.
